name: codegraph
description: Code intelligence and knowledge graph for any codebase: one codegraph_explore call returns the relevant symbols' source and the call paths between them, instead of search/read loops. Wraps the locally installed codegraph CLI (v1.6+) via `codegraph serve --mcp`.

description_i18n.en: Code intelligence and knowledge graph for any codebase: one codegraph_explore call returns the relevant symbols' source and the call paths between them, instead of search/read loops. Wraps the locally installed codegraph CLI (v1.6+) via `codegraph serve --mcp`.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 任意代码库的代码智能与知识图谱：一次 codegraph_explore 调用即返回相关符号的源码及它们之间的调用路径，免去反复搜索/读文件。封装本机安装的 codegraph CLI（v1.6+），经 `codegraph serve --mcp` 提供。
